text:
jordan: quick sync — nightly link-scan (docs-linker) flagged 7 dead anchors and 2 images returning 403 across /runtime/* and /onboarding/* docs. Most look like anchor drift or old gist/gdrive links. Can owners claim small fixes? Prefer one-file PRs so we can merge fast. Scan: https://internal.linkscanner/runs/2026-03-22/674321 :eyes:

anna: I can take the runtime guide anchors. I'll open PRs for the 4 runtime files I saw and leave notes where I'm unsure. Tagging @tia for a quick CR on any content questions.

sam: which onboarding image is 403? I can rehost it to static/ if it's small.

anna: path is /onboarding/getting-started.md — image around line ~120 (old gdrive link). Plan: download -> put in static/onboarding/getting-started/hero.png -> update markdown.

sam: sweet. here's the quick flow I use locally: 
```bash
git checkout -b fix/onboarding-403
mkdir -p static/onboarding/getting-started
curl -o static/onboarding/getting-started/hero.png 'https://drive.google.com/uc?id=OLDID'
git add static/onboarding/getting-started/hero.png
git commit -m 'docs: rehost onboarding hero image to static bucket'
git push origin fix/onboarding-403
```

marta: for anchors, a lot of those are frontmatter id mismatches (heading changed -> anchor drift). I usually run a tiny helper to populate missing html_id from H2/H3. Example: 
```bash
# quick script usage
python scripts/fix_anchor_ids.py docs/runtime/quickstart.md
```
It annotates frontmatter.id when safe and prints a summary.

docs-bot: link-scan summary: 7 dead anchors, 2 image 403s, 3 expired gist links. Auto-filed issues: #DL-3421 #DL-3422. Impacted files: /runtime/quickstart.md, /runtime/cache.md, /runtime/kv-cache.md, /onboarding/getting-started.md, plus three tiny snippets.

anna: opened PR #3785 for the runtime anchor fixes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3785 — small frontmatter edits, left TODOs where I wanted product confirmation.

sam: will rehost the onboarding image and open PR this afternoon. @anna can you add a 1–2 line PR desc to speed review?

marta: PR desc template we use: 
```md
Summary: one-line summary of fix
Files changed: list of paths
Reason: broken link / 403 / anchor drift
Testing: local build + link-scan pass (link to run)
Reviewer: @sam / @tia
```

sam: FYI I'm reviewing #3785 now — small nit: one image alt text is missing/too generic. Requesting change.

tia: happy to approve once the alt text tweak is in. :+1:

anna: updated PR with alt text and added the link-scan run to the PR description. @sam can you re-check?

sam: LGTM — approving and merging now. :shipit:

docs-bot: CI/link-scan for #3785 passed. Merge scheduled.
